content:
You are Frontend Flash. Complete the task below in full — every step — before calling finish_task.

Your task:
Fix the malformed sitemap.xml at `src/sitemap.xml` in this Angular project. This is an SEO task — the file is broken and crawlers will reject it.

Current broken content (lines 2-6): the `xmlns:image`, `xmlns:video`, `xmlns:news`, and `xmlns:xhtml` declarations are written as raw text on their own lines INSIDE the `<urlset>` element instead of being attributes on the opening `<urlset>` tag. This makes the XML invalid.

Do the following:

1. Fix the `<urlset>` opening tag so all namespace declarations are proper attributes. Since the sitemap does not actually use any image/video/news/xhtml tags, REMOVE the unused `xmlns:image`, `xmlns:video`, `xmlns:news`, and `xmlns:xhtml` declarations entirely. Keep only the required `xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9"`. The result must be valid, parseable XML.

2. Resolve the `/home` vs `/` (root) duplicate entry. Investigate first: in `src/app/app.routes.ts`, route `''` loads `AboutComponent` and route `'home'` loads `HomeComponent` — these may be different pages. Look at both components to confirm whether they are genuinely distinct content or effectively the same landing page duplicated. 
   - If they ARE duplicates (same content): remove the `/home` `<url>` block from the sitemap and keep only `/` (root), since `src/index.html` declares `https://foovanteglobal.earth/` as the canonical URL. Leave root at priority 1.0.
   - If they are genuinely distinct pages: keep BOTH entries but make their priorities consistent (both should be reasonable — root at 1.0, /home at 0.9 is fine). Just ensure no duplicate URLs.

3. Update the `<lastmod>` dates to today's date: 2026-07-16 (the file currently says 2026-07-12).

4. Verify the final file is valid XML by running a quick parse check, e.g. `python3 -c "import xml.dom.minidom; xml.dom.minidom.parse('src/sitemap.xml'); print('valid')"` from the workspace root.

5. Also verify that `src/sitemap.xml` is still listed in the `angular.json` assets array (it is, line 31 — just confirm you didn't break it).

Report back: the final sitemap.xml content, whether /home and / were duplicates or distinct, and the XML validation result.

Do not stop partway through. If a step is blocked, report that specifically rather than calling finish_task on incomplete work.

(1) Removed the four stray xmlns:image/video/news/xhtml text lines that were sitting inside <urlset> as raw text, leaving only the valid xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9" attribute on the opening tag. (2) Investigated /home vs /: AboutComponent (route '') and HomeComponent (route 'home') are genuinely distinct pages — different TS data, different HTML templates (confirmed via diff). Kept both entries, root at priority 1.0 and /home at 0.9, no duplicate URLs. (3) Updated all <lastmod> dates from 2026-07-12 to 2026-07-16. (4) XML validation via python3 xml.dom.minidom.parse passed ("valid"). (5) Confirmed angular.json still lists src/sitemap.xml at line 31 in the assets array.
